verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own public API, with an API Reference page and an agent-friendly markdown version, so programmatic access is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows the API matches everything the UI can do. The probe also found no published OpenAPI spec at the usual paths. Missing for 10: evidence of full API/UI feature parity, per-feature API coverage (dashboards, monitors, SLOs, incidents, etc. via API), a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
